atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS base directive. Use `@tailwind base`, `@tailwind components`, or `@tailwind utilities` to inject Tailwind's styles.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: tells the engine which directories/files to scan for class names.

atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: defines design tokens (colors, spacing, fonts, etc.) as CSS custom properties.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: registers a custom utility class.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: registers a custom variant (e.g. `dark`, `hover`, `focus`).

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: applies a set of utility classes inline inside a CSS rule.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: adds styles to a specific Tailwind layer (base, components, utilities).

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: points to an external Tailwind config file.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: loads a Tailwind plugin.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: applies a variant to styles inside a block.
